head.title: Your website, rebuilt — CyanShip
head.description: Your first screen decides whether a customer calls you or closes the tab. I rebuild the site of a business that already has one. From $1,000.

hero.heading_line2: than your website makes you look.
hero.description: Your site fell behind you. I bring it back up to your level.

how_it_works.label: Process
how_it_works.heading: What happens after you send the address.
how_it_works.description: No call, no discovery workshop, no questionnaire about where you see your business in five years.
how_it_works.step_1_sub: Name, email, your website. Thirty seconds.
how_it_works.step_2_title: You get a rewritten first screen
how_it_works.step_2_sub: Built on your own material. Free, no conditions attached.
how_it_works.step_3_sub: An exact number for your site, not a range.
how_it_works.step_4_sub: The first screen stays yours either way.

pricing.label: Price
pricing.heading: From $1,000. Said out loud.
pricing.description: A hidden price makes a person write in to ask for it — and that is exactly why they never write. So here it is.
pricing.price_note: There is no upper bound, because scope has none: more pages, custom features and integrations move the number. The exact one comes after I have seen your site.
pricing.include_1: Every screen your site has today, rebuilt: structure, text, design.
pricing.include_2: Built for the phone first — that is where your customer opens it.
pricing.include_3: Speed treated as a build requirement, not a fix for later.
pricing.include_4: One clear action per screen: call, message, or a form that reaches your inbox.
pricing.include_5: Launched on your own domain. All of it belongs to you.

ladder.label: After launch
ladder.heading: The site is the first step, not the whole road.
ladder.description: Each step is a separate decision, taken once the previous one has paid for itself. No package, nothing bundled in.
ladder.step_2_description: Someone keeps it running, and you get to see what visitors actually do on it.
ladder.step_3_title: An AI assistant on your site
ladder.step_3_description: Answers your customers around the clock, in their own language. The chat on this page is one.
ladder.note: Prices for the second and third steps are quoted when you get there. Naming a number now would be a guess.

proof.label: Level
proof.heading: This page is not a screenshot of a portfolio.
proof.description: Sign-in, a live Stripe checkout, a metered balance — all of it runs on this page right now, and all of it was built here. It is not an invitation to open an account. It is the shortest way to check what the person rebuilding your site can actually build.

final_cta.label: Start
final_cta.heading: Send the address. That is the whole first step.
final_cta.description: Name, email, your website, and optionally what already bothers you about it. No call, no meeting, no brief to fill in.

portfolio.label: Work
portfolio.heading: Products that are running right now.
portfolio.description: Not concepts. Every one of these went live with real users, real money and real staff behind it. Open any card to see the screens.
portfolio.nda_note: Internal screens recreated for this case. Originals under NDA.
portfolio.slider_label: Drag to compare before and after

status.title: STATUS English School
status.summary: A speaking-first English school ran on a legacy site and a hand-kept list of leads. Now: 12 pages across two languages, one inbox where every trial request lands, and staff who publish prices and news without asking a developer. 53 redirects carried the old search rankings over; pages deliver in 0.1 to 0.3 seconds.

finly.title: Finly
finly.summary: A fintech product for small businesses: payment QR codes and payment links generated to the national banking standard in seconds, so a customer scans instead of typing bank details by hand. Subscription billing, local acquiring, branded payment pages. Live in production, running its own payment infrastructure.

wish-hub.title: Wish Hub
wish-hub.summary: A social wishlist where people create, share and reserve gifts, so nobody buys the same present twice. Three privacy levels per wish, automated product import from a store link, three languages, web push. Live at wish-hub.net: 575 commits, 116,000 lines of code.

buildup-school.title: BuildUp School
buildup-school.summary: One product instead of three: a landing page that sells, a learning platform for students, and admin tooling for staff. Five roles with their own dashboards, drag-and-drop scheduling across groups, teachers and rooms, and a course editor that non-technical staff run on their own.

knockai.title: KnockAI
knockai.summary: A field operations platform for door-to-door teams: GPS check-ins with distance validation, dwell tracking on timed tasks, and earnings that turn into payout requests. Every state stays consistent across the mobile app, the backend and the database.

split.title: Split Ticketing
split.summary: A nightclub sold tickets on paper and checked guests in by hand. Now guests buy online and get a QR ticket instantly, while door staff scan on a dedicated screen that catches used and duplicate tickets in real time. Revenue per event is visible as it comes in.

cycle8.title: Cycle8
cycle8.summary: The frontend of an enterprise B2B trading platform, where business users run trade workflows through dense data screens. Filterable, sortable tables with live status, role-based access per user type, and a legacy codebase moved to a modern frontend without breaking the workflows people were in the middle of.

head.title: CyanShip – From Idea to Revenue in 4 Weeks
head.description: B2B platform development with AI, payments, and auth built in. Next.js + NestJS. Fast time-to-market, zero agency overhead.

hero.description: Production-ready B2B platforms — AI, payments, and auth baked in from day one. Built on a battle-tested Next.js & NestJS core. Zero agency overhead.

problem.label: Approach
problem.heading: Skip the Boilerplate. Focus on Business.
problem.paragraph_1: Most startup budgets are burned on rebuilding authentication, payment integrations, and now — AI features. I've already built all of it.
problem.paragraph_2: With CyanShip — my pre-built core — we bypass the setup phase and start building your custom logic on day one.
problem.feature_architecture_description: Built on industry standards. When you hire an in-house team, they can take over instantly without rewriting legacy code.
problem.feature_typed_description: Built for absolute reliability. Your product won't crash during critical investor demos or sudden traffic spikes.
problem.feature_scale_description: A solid foundation with built-in Stripe billing and AI integration. Handles your first 10 paying customers just as easily as your first 10,000.

dogfooding.label: Proof
dogfooding.heading: You Are Looking at the Code Right Now
dogfooding.description: I don't just sell this architecture; I run my business on it. This site — including its AI chat, Stripe billing, and auth — is built on the exact same CyanShip core your product will use.

demo_video.label: Demo
demo_video.heading: See It Working. All of It.
demo_video.description: You've tried the individual features. Now watch the complete flow — from first sign-in to AI chat — in one uncut walkthrough.
demo_video.highlight_auth: Google sign-in — three seconds, you're in
demo_video.highlight_billing: Stripe checkout with a live payment
demo_video.highlight_dashboard: Dashboard — balance updates in real time
demo_video.note: Full source code. Zero tech debt. This is your starting point.

workflow.label: Workflow
workflow.heading: No Useless Meetings. Just Daily Progress.
workflow.description: I value your time. My workflow is designed for founders who prefer tangible results over endless Zoom calls.
workflow.step_async_description: Slack and email for structured, searchable decisions.
workflow.step_video_description: Concise Loom screen recordings showcasing new features and UI/UX flows.
workflow.step_code_description: Regular repository pushes. You always own your IP.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.heading: Predictable Pricing. Zero Hidden Fees.
pricing.include_4: AI chat integration with usage-based billing
pricing.faq_1_q: What if I need more complex features?
pricing.faq_1_a: Send a brief or a quick Loom video with your requirements. I'll review it asynchronously and provide a fixed-price quote. No endless discovery calls.
pricing.faq_2_q: Do I own the code and IP?
pricing.faq_2_a: Absolutely. I sign an NDA before we even discuss your idea. Upon final payment, 100% of the Intellectual Property (IP) and source code rights are legally transferred to your entity. No vendor lock-in.
pricing.faq_3_a: 50% upfront to secure your slot, 50% upon successful delivery. I operate as a registered independent contractor. Payments are made securely via SWIFT, Payoneer, or wire transfer against official B2B invoices.
pricing.faq_4_a: I'll set up your deployment on Vercel or your preferred platform as part of the package.
pricing.faq_5_q: What happens after the MVP is launched?
pricing.faq_5_a: You have full control. You can take the clean, documented Next.js/NestJS codebase to an in-house team, or retain me for ongoing feature development via a monthly retainer or fixed hourly rate.
pricing.faq_6_q: Does the MVP include AI features?
pricing.faq_6_a: Yes. The CyanShip core ships with a production-ready AI chat module — streaming responses, per-message billing, rate limiting, and abuse protection. You can use it as-is for customer support or adapt it to your domain. No extra cost.

footer_cta.label: Contact
footer_cta.heading: Have a raw idea? Let's map it out.
footer_cta.description: Turn your concept into an actionable technical plan. Submit your details, and you'll get a clear architecture roadmap and a fixed-price estimate. The document is yours to keep, even if we don't work together.
